description: A dark, moody oil-style still life in a stone vaulted room. Centre: a clear glass conical flask holding a liquid with white sediment at its base. Right: a polished brass compound microscope on a worn wooden bench, with a small porcelain dish and glass jars nearby. Left foreground: a crumpled cloth in green and cream with reddish-brown stains, and a faint red mark on the table edge. A lit oil lamp sits at the far left. No visible text, frame or people.
